newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Orenburg oil says 1996 net profit 457 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Orenburg oil says 1996 net profit 457 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Oil company ONAKO owns 50.7 percent of AO Orenburgneft voting shares, while employees own 13.8 percent.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards on a cash basis. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
